=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/ci_budget_watch.py:207-236 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: gate_job_findings reads the latest completed test-and-mark-stable.yml run (`runs?status=completed&per_page=1`) and measures it against `job_timeouts(gate_path)` from the current checkout, but never checks the run's head_sha, created_at or job layout against the checked-out workflow.
  WHY: On the push that merges this PR, the latest completed gate run is still a serial pre-split run (46009933351 at 109/135 = 0.81, or 45927857867 at 125/135 = 0.93). budget-watch then opens an `ai:ci-budget` issue asking for the split this PR already made, and the cooldown does not stop it because 0.926 is above the 0.9 `CI_BUDGET_REFILE_URGENT_RATIO`. The same false finding comes back whenever a gate job's layout or timeout-minutes changes. Four reviewers rated this MAJOR; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash gave no severity.
- scripts/ci_budget_watch.py:192-384 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A gate finding has no run_id, and its issue body (the gate branch of issue_body, lines 264-273) links only to the ci.yml budget-watch run_url (line 384). The measured test-and-mark-stable.yml run id (gate_run_id) is only printed to the log (line 235).
  WHY: By the time an operator or the clarify/plan agent reads the issue, a newer gate run has completed, so the run whose step timings triggered the finding cannot be found from the issue. gemini and minimax rated this MAJOR; glm gave no severity and confidence 3. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised the same point only as a hardening suggestion, not as a finding.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3274-3276 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The new jobs.validate-scripts.strategy.matrix doubles runner use for `validate-scripts` from one runner to two (`max-parallel: 2`), and the PR description does not justify it.
  WHY: §33 requires the PR description to justify added runner use and to compare runner counts, because concurrent release gates could congest the runner pool. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly dropped this item: max-parallel is bounded, the reason is in the workflow comment at lines 3264-3270, and the gate runs about once a day.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/ci_budget_watch.py:gate_job_findings, lines 216-230; main() lines 374-376 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The latest completed test-and-mark-stable.yml run is measured against the job layout and timeouts in the current checkout. The run's head_sha, created_at and job-name shape are never compared with the checked-out workflow.
  WHY: budget-watch (ci.yml line 5101) runs on the merge push. The latest completed gate run is then pre-split (46009933351 at 0.81, 45927857867 at 0.93), and its job name `validate-scripts` looks up the 135-minute timeout. The script opens an `ai:ci-budget` issue with CHECK_TRIAGE_ISSUES_TOKEN (ci.yml line 5128) whose body (lines 265-273) asks for the split this PR already made. The cooldown does not apply, and nothing closes the issue. Suggested fix: skip a gate job that has no matrix suffix when the current file's job defines strategy.matrix, or skip any run created before the gate file last changed, and log `CI_BUDGET_GATE outcome=stale` (5-8 lines).
- TASK_GAP

  Expected change site: PR description
  Evidence of absence: The PR body has only "Automated implementation. Closes ...", the pre-push test gate report and the Acceptance table. The reasoning exists only in .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml lines 3258-3272 and in changelog.d/10220-release-validate-scripts-legs.md.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "If the plan splits the job ... state the jobs per gate run before and after in the PR body, and bound the fan-out with max-parallel" (issue #10220, Runner use §33; unattended §26)
  Expected change site: PR description
  Evidence of absence: The PR body has no 1-before / 2-after count. `max-parallel: 2` is at workflow line 3276. "2 instead of 1" appears only in the workflow comment (lines 3268-3270) and in the changelog fragment table.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING: scripts/ci_budget_watch.py job_duration_findings line 192 and issue_body lines 265-273 | risk_score=2
  PROBLEM: A gate finding's issue links only the ci.yml budget-watch run (run_url, line 384). The measured gate run id is only logged (line 235). When --run-id is empty, run_url can end in "/actions/runs/".
  WHY: Suggested fix: add `"run_id": gate_run_id` to gate findings and a "Measured run: {server}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}" line to the gate branch of issue_body (4-6 lines).
- Dropped after verification (3 related items): the run-id injection at scripts/ci_budget_watch.py lines 221-225 (non-int and bool ids are rejected); "gate_jobs only partly validated" (malformed fields are tolerated at lines 163-187, with the broad fail-open except at line 231); the matrix runner-doubling item (max-parallel: 2 at line 3276, reason at lines 3264-3270). The gemini "tests next to" gap was also dropped as satisfied.

  WHY: After merge, the latest completed run is still serial and pre-split (e.g., run 46009933351) and above the 75% ratio, so an `ai:ci-budget` issue is opened for a duration this PR already addressed.

  WHY: Recipients cannot tell which release-gate run triggered the warning, so they cannot diagnose or verify it.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:jobs.validate-scripts.strategy.matrix (lines 3274-3276) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The matrix doubles runner use for `validate-scripts` from one runner to two (`max-parallel: 2`).
  WHY: §33 requires the PR description to justify the added runner use and compare runner counts. It does neither.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/ci_budget_watch.py:gate_job_findings, the runs-listing block at lines 213-217 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The function reads `actions/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml/runs?status=completed&per_page=1` and measures it against `job_timeouts(gate_path)` without comparing the run's `head_sha` or `created_at` to the checked-out gate workflow.
  WHY: The first budget-watch run after merge reads pre-split run 45927857867 (0.926, above the 0.9 `CI_BUDGET_REFILE_URGENT_RATIO`) and opens an `ai:ci-budget` issue asking for the split this PR already made. `test_gate_findings_skipped_when_gate_workflow_missing` does not cover a head-SHA mismatch. Suggested fix: compare head_sha to the file's SHA, or created_at to the file's last change; on mismatch return [] with `CI_BUDGET_GATE outcome=stale run_id=...` and add a unit test.
- scripts/ci_budget_watch.py:issue_body `_is_gate_finding(finding)` branch, lines 264-273; gate finding construction | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: A gate finding has no `run_id`. The gate issue body uses only workflow/subject/job, and `run_url` is the ci.yml budget-watch run URL, not the measured gate run.
  WHY: Readers cannot open the gate run whose timings they need, because "latest completed" has moved on. Suggested fix: add `"run_id": gate_run_id` and a "Measured run:" line (2-4 lines), asserted in `test_gate_findings_go_through_the_issue_path`.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Pick one and say why in the PR body." (linked issue #10220, "Changes" #1)
  Expected change site: The PR description for this pull request (the body posted by `gh pr create --body`)
  Evidence of absence: The PR body has only the auto-generated Closes line, the gate report and the acceptance table.
